articles.summary: Reduce the risk of creating a legacy bespoke system with Authzed's suite of authorization tooling, including SpiceDB, an open-source solution for implementing fine-grained permissions modeled on ABAC and now featuring caveats for dynamic policies.
articles.title: Caveats: A Scalable Solution for Policy

articles.summary: Learn about connection draining in databases and its impact on application availability. Discover what it is, how it works, and how to handle it properly, with a focus on CockroachDB and Go applications.
articles.title: Getting Database Connection Draining Right
